source.observed_pattern: A Snowflake model builds paired numeric samples in a CTE and computes COVAR_SAMP over the sample.
source.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a grouped calibration report. Because MariaDB 10.11.7 has no native COVAR_SAMP aggregate, the query uses the equivalent guarded sample-covariance formula (n * SUM(x*y) - SUM(x) * SUM(y)) / (n * (n - 1)) over each region. The CTE and singleton region are retained to exercise grouped sample covariance and SQL NULL when fewer than two pairs exist.

fixture_notes: North has pairs (1,2), (2,4), (3,6), giving covariance 2. South has (2,10), (4,14), (6,18), giving covariance 8. East has one pair and therefore NULL sample covariance.
determinism_notes: All paired values and region labels are fixed; region ordering is explicit and no clocks, randomness, limits, or concurrent schedules are used.

steps.sql: WITH calibration_samples AS (SELECT 'North' AS region_code, 1 AS measured_x, 2 AS measured_y UNION ALL SELECT 'North', 2, 4 UNION ALL SELECT 'North', 3, 6 UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 2, 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 4, 14 UNION ALL SELECT 'South', 6, 18 UNION ALL SELECT 'East', 9, 12) SELECT region_code, COUNT(*) AS sample_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN (COUNT(*) * SUM(measured_x * measured_y) - SUM(measured_x) * SUM(measured_y)) / (COUNT(*) * (COUNT(*) - 1)) ELSE NULL END AS sample_covariance FROM calibration_samples GROUP BY region_code ORDER BY region_code
